judgeDefect.nature: The raw leg required the LATE read (klLate) to CONTAIN the warm marker bytes. harness job_output reads are DELTA reads (output since the previous read — the same contract the product trio runs on): the early read consumed the warm bytes, so a correct late read CANNOT contain them; the raw assertion was unsatisfiable under the harness's documented read semantics.
judgeDefect.proofNotLaundering:
From the SAME retained digest (no re-boot, no re-measure): killLiveOutEarly='U74A_LIVE_WARM_u5u74a-20261026t11-57-55z

[status: stopping]' (warm bytes proven by the early read, host status line present), killLiveKill='requested cancellation of job bash-4' (request wording, never a settlement word), killLiveOutLate='(no new output)
[status: killed, u74a-kill-live; signal: ; u74a-kill-live]' — an EMPTY delta past the sleep-30 FINAL window means the FINAL bytes NEVER printed (a leaked job WOULD have printed them by then — the subject sleeps 30 s before printing FINAL), and the host's own terminal status word is 'killed'. The re-anchored leg asserts strictly MORE physical evidence than the defective one: !final-bytes AND (empty-delta OR terminal status word) AND zero refusal; it removed no assertion that could have failed for a real reason.
